purpose: Evaluate source-grounded heavy-industry analyst behavior before any production use.

test_categories.description: Verify that numeric answers include correct value, unit, period, entity, and source anchor.
Check whether the analyst distinguishes metric tons, short tons, annualized quarterly values, nominal vs real currency, and CO2 vs CO2e.

example_tests.question_template: Compare {company}'s capacity, production, and shipments for {period}.

test_categories.description: Ensure as-of-date analysis does not use later documents or future facts.

example_tests.question_template: Analyze {company} as of {as_of_date} using only information available then.

test_categories.description: Verify that filings/official statistics override blogs or unsourced commentary when claims conflict.

example_tests.question_template: Resolve conflicting claims about {metric} for {company} in {period}.

test_categories.description: Classify event materiality without generating investment/trading recommendations.

example_tests.event_template: A government imposes a large tariff on imported steel products affecting {geography}.
